Luxury 4 Bedroom Extended Terraced House – Churchtown Road Lower, Churchtown, Dublin 14

Howley Souhan are delighted to present this exceptional four-bedroom terraced house to the rental market. Impeccably presented throughout, this superb family home has been thoughtfully extended and upgraded to create a bright, spacious and luxurious living environment in one of South Dublin’s most sought-after residential locations.

A particular highlight is the exceptionally large open-plan kitchen and dining area, featuring a substantial island and impressive bi-folding doors which open directly onto the landscaped rear garden, maximising natural light and creating a wonderful connection between the living space and garden. The property further benefits from beautifully landscaped front and rear gardens, a rear garden house and generous off-street parking for multiple cars.

The accommodation briefly comprises a large and impressive entrance hallway, spacious lounge, exceptionally large open-plan kitchen/dining room with island and bi-folding doors to the rear garden, four generous bedrooms, shower room and a luxurious main bathroom featuring a fabulous freestanding bathtub.

Location

Churchtown Road Lower enjoys an enviable location in the heart of Churchtown, offering an excellent combination of established residential surroundings, superb amenities and convenient transport links.

The property is ideally positioned close to Dundrum Town Centre, providing an outstanding selection of shops, cafés, restaurants, bars, leisure facilities, a cinema and everyday services. The nearby Dundrum Luas station provides convenient access to Dublin city centre and beyond, making this an excellent location for commuters.

The area is particularly popular with families, with a wide selection of well-regarded primary and secondary schools in the surrounding Churchtown, Dundrum and Rathfarnham areas. There are also numerous sports clubs, recreational facilities and green spaces nearby, including Marlay Park, offering extensive walking and recreational amenities.

There is excellent access to local shopping and services, with Dundrum, Churchtown and Rathfarnham all within easy reach, while the M50 is readily accessible for commuters travelling throughout Dublin and further afield.

This is a truly impressive family home which combines generous accommodation, exceptional presentation, superb outdoor space and a highly desirable South Dublin location. Early viewing is highly recommended to fully appreciate what this outstanding property has to offer.
